stem: In a Lakeflow Declarative Pipeline for Sakura Digital Bank, daily_cash_flow sums deposits and withdrawals per day from txn_silver. Corrections sometimes update or delete older rows in txn_silver. Which dataset type should daily_cash_flow be so that its totals stay correct?
choices: A streaming table that reads txn_silver with STREAM()
A materialized view
A temporary view that is not published
An append-only streaming table with a watermark on event_time
explanation_ja: マテリアライズドビューは、元のテーブルの更新や削除も反映して結果を正しく保ちます(できるときは増分で更新)。ストリーミングテーブルは追記された行だけを1回処理するので、過去の行の更新や削除は集計に反映されません。

stem: Rows in txn_silver must never have a NULL account_id. Bad rows should be removed from txn_silver, the pipeline should keep running, and the number of bad rows should be recorded. Which expectation fits?
choices: CONSTRAINT valid_account EXPECT (account_id IS NOT NULL)
CONSTRAINT valid_account EXPECT (account_id IS NOT NULL) ON VIOLATION FAIL UPDATE
A Delta CHECK constraint on txn_silver
CONSTRAINT valid_account EXPECT (account_id IS NOT NULL) ON VIOLATION DROP ROW
explanation_ja: ON VIOLATION DROP ROW は違反した行を書き込まずに捨て、件数をイベントログに記録し、パイプラインは止まりません。何も付けない EXPECT は行を残して記録だけ、FAIL UPDATE は更新を失敗させます。Delta の CHECK 制約は違反した書き込み全体を失敗させます。

stem: An Auto Loader stream infers the schema of transaction JSON files and uses the default schema evolution mode. New files start to include a column channel. What happens?
choices: The stream stops with an error after recording channel in the schema location; after a restart it continues with channel as a new column
The stream keeps running and puts channel values in _rescued_data
The stream ignores channel and never adds it
The stream adds channel immediately without stopping
explanation_ja: 既定の addNewColumns では、新しい列を見つけるとスキーマの保存先に列を追加してからストリームを止めます。再起動すると新しい列ありで続きます(ジョブやパイプラインの再試行で自動で再開させるのが一般的)。B は rescue、C は none の動きです。

stem: You want a query that shows, for each pipeline update, how many rows passed and failed each expectation in txn_silver. Where do you get this data?
choices: system.billing.usage
DESCRIBE HISTORY txn_silver
The pipeline event log (for example with the event_log() function), from flow_progress events
The Spark UI of the last update
explanation_ja: エクスペクテーションの結果は、パイプラインのイベントログの flow_progress イベント(details の data_quality)に記録されます。event_log() 関数で SQL から読めます。DESCRIBE HISTORY は Delta の操作履歴で、品質の件数はありません。

stem: Analysts have SELECT on the view v_txn_summary, which is owned by the group data-eng and reads txn_silver. An admin revokes data-eng's SELECT on txn_silver. What happens when an analyst queries the view?
choices: It still works, because analysts have SELECT on the view
It fails, because access to txn_silver is checked against the view owner, who no longer has it
It works but returns no rows
It works only for metastore admins
explanation_ja: ビューの元テーブルへの権限は、ビューの所有者で確認されます。所有者 data-eng が txn_silver の SELECT を失うと、ビューの SELECT を持つアナリストも読めなくなります。
